Thanks Maya — quick read-through from Procurement and Legal. A few gaps before we can create a PO:

1) GL limits: Contract requires $1M per occurrence / $2M aggregate (your COI shows $1M/1M). Can you confirm if an umbrella policy or higher aggregate is available?
2) Additional insured: COI lists Redwood as "Addl Insured - Operations & Products" — Legal wants the certificate endorsement # included or the endorsement itself attached.
3) Waiver of Subrogation: Our contracts require waiver of subrogation in favor of Redwood for GL and Employers Liability where applicable. Your COI indicates no waiver.
4) Cyber limits: We require $5M minimum for third-party liability. Your declaration page shows $2M. Is a higher limit available?

Laura (CC'd) — can you confirm whether we can proceed with conditional PO (create PO with note to update COI) or do we require all items before PO issuance?

Priyom — FYI for finance timeline; vendor indicated carrier lead time 3–5 business days for endorsements. If Legal insists on endorsements up front, that will shift the activation date.

Next steps: Maya, could you escalate to your broker and share ETA for endorsements/updated limits? If you prefer, we can accept a binding letter from carrier confirming pending endorsement.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference

Sean —

We generally need the endorsements for Additional Insured and Waiver of Subrogation prior to PO for vendors with access to customer data or who will be integrated into our runtime. Acme will be running a scheduled SFTP feed of logs and will have a service account in our staging environment (so they touch non-production data). This falls into the "data handling" bucket.

Options:
- Option A (preferred): Wait for endorsements and revised limits, then issue full PO.
- Option B (conditional): Issue a PO with an activation hold and financial controls (cap spend to $10K monthly until COI is updated), require carrier letter confirming endorsement in-progress, and schedule a compliance re-check in 10 business days.

Given the 3–5 day broker ETA Maya mentioned, Option B could work if Finance signs off. Priyom — can you confirm if Finance can accept a conditional PO with a $10K monthly cap and invoice routing to our restricted account until full compliance is received?

Laura
Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference
